newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent, NYMEX extend Friday's drift.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent, NYMEX extend Friday's drift.

text.p: Crude futures prices in Asia were weaker on Monday in thin trading with prices drifting further.
March Brent futures, trading on SIMEX, were quoted at $22.08/$22.25 per barrel, after London lost 16 cents to settle at $22.26.
April traded at $21.80 on 10 lots, down six cents from the London close.
Brokers said there was little to indicate a break in the drift of the markets.
March Brent broke support at $22.30 and the bears would now target $22.00 -- a downward spike and three month low hit during December trading.
The NYMEX complex continued to drift, but in thin dealings.
March crude was off nine cents at $23.96 on ACCESS, dropping below New York's intraday low of $24.03 and towards last week's low of $23.80.
Brokers said the rate of decline still presented a short covering rally, but there was little to indicate prices should rise for the time being.
